_meta.source: Official updated purity-certificate set supplied by the client (batch date 2026-07-17), replacing the prior hotlinked WordPress certificates. The 19 purity PDFs are now self-hosted under public/coas/. purity = measured UPLC/MS value parsed directly from each certificate; label = certificate lot number (batch id) — the trust signal.
_meta.coaUrl_note: coaUrl = self-hosted purity-certificate PDF under /coas/ (no more hotlinking the client's WP). This official set is PURITY certificates only; the prior (partly mislabeled) hotlinked endotoxin URLs have been removed. Spec on every cert is >98% (blends >=98%). For multi-component blend certs the recorded purity is the LOWEST component purity (most conservative honest figure); per-component values are in data_quality_flags.
_meta.glp_coding_note: HARD RULE #1 — GLP-compound trade names are coded and NEVER written expanded anywhere in this repo. The source zip filenames carried expanded trade names; PDFs were extracted to a scratch dir OUTSIDE the repo, renamed to coded form (GLP1-SM / GLP2-TZ / GLP3-RT), and only then copied into public/coas/. All coaUrl paths and local filenames are coded. Verified via repo-wide grep: zero expanded-name leaks.

Two live slugs both begin 'mots-c-...': id 644 is the real MOTS-C (cert PTR-1960660-P); id 643 is Selank (cert PTR-4692745-P). Do not swap them.

GLOW (1849) cert PTR-6055127-P components BPC-157 99.31% / TB-500 99.27% / GHK-Cu 99.56% -> recorded 99.27%. KLOW (658) cert PTR-2431473-P components BPC-157 99.25% / TB-500 99.16% / GHK-Cu 99.56% / KPV 99.21% -> recorded 99.16%.

KPV has no standalone product; it is a component of the KLOW blend. Its standalone certificate (PTR-5154196-P, 99.23%) is hosted on the klow entry as componentCoaUrl (additive field; UI may ignore it for now).
